snapshot.title: Add return to Earth button in mining minigame
snapshot.description: Allow players to exit mining early by pressing a button that returns them to the main game loop (preview scene). Should work when fuel runs out or player wants to leave early.

changes.newValue: Added RETURN TO EARTH button (bottom-right). Connects to _on_return_pressed() which calls _complete_mining() to emit mining_completed signal. Preview scene already handles this signal. Button turns red with 'FUEL DEPLETED' text when fuel reaches 0. Works for early exit or fuel depletion.
